description_en: Resets and upgrades the log analysis feature. You can call this operation only when the log analysis feature uses the pay-as-you-go billing method
description_zh: 重置并升级日志分析服务。仅日志后付费模式支持调用
kebab_example: aliyun sas reset-log-shipper --ttl 180 --hot-ttl 7 --log-meta-list Status=enabled HotTtl=7 Ttl=60 ConfigLogStore=sas-security-log --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetLogShipper

parameters.description_en:
The global log retention period.

>  This parameter is supported only when the log analysis feature uses the pay-as-you-go billing method.
parameters.description_zh:
全局日志保存天数。

> 仅日志后付费模式支持。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.name: ttl

parameters.description_en:
The global retention period of hot data.

>  The value of this parameter must be at least 7 and smaller than the log retention period. Unit: days.
parameters.description_zh:
全局热存储层数据保存时间。

> 取值范围：大于等于7天，小于日志存储时间。
